title: Pi 4B integrated power, Sharp display and swappable GPIO baseboard

currentCapacity.rationale: 3A Type-C advertisement only; 820 ohm TPS259531 ILM limits downstream to about 2.63A high corner before resistor tolerance. 0.75mm is conservative versus ~0.67mm IPC-2221 estimate for 2.7A/2oz/10C. Validate port-pin aggregation and actual copper.
Post-TPS259531 input limited around 2.63A high corner before resistor tolerance; 0.75mm conservative versus ~0.67mm IPC-2221 for 2.7A/2oz/10C. Validate fault current and temperature.

BAT_RAW.rationale: Size copper trunk above 6A/2oz/10C estimate; package escape remains a local limitation.

escape.rationale: BQ25622 RYK pad 8 is fine pitch; only the sub-1mm land escape may narrow to 0.2mm before a 2mm battery trunk. This is not a 6A trace rating.

currentCapacity.rationale: BQ25622 battery-path ceiling is 6A continuous; ~1.78mm external 2oz/10C estimate. This is a copper target, not a verified package or pack rating.

SYS_RAW.rationale: Size copper trunk above 6A/2oz/10C estimate; package escape remains a local limitation.

escape.rationale: BQ25622 RYK pad 9 permits only a short fine-pitch land escape; bulk SYS must be 2mm or copper plane.

currentCapacity.rationale: SYS may carry almost the BQ25622 6A battery-path limit; ~1.78mm external 2oz/10C estimate. Actual package escape, vias, copper and thermal qualification remain required.

escape.rationale: Short RYK pad 16 escape only; switch-loop trunk and inductor landing must remain wide.

currentCapacity.rationale: BQ25622 switch current limit is 3.5A class. Short, local SW-to-inductor copper still needs package-specific loop review and thermal validation.

CHG_PMID.rationale: BQ25622 supplier land is0.2240026mm; routed KiCad copper is quantized to0.224mm. Declare that existing geometric minimum explicitly instead of a sub-micron false width failure. Nominal width is unchanged; this does not rate high-current trunks.

BOOST_SW.rationale: Peak switch current approaches 8A; keep the inductor-switch loop short with wide copper.

currentCapacity.calculationMethod: IPC-2221 external trace estimate for approximate RMS
currentCapacity.rationale: Switch path carries >5.8A approximate input current at full load plus ripple; 6A/2oz/10C estimates ~1.78mm. This does not replace switching-loss/thermal validation.
5.1V source target 3.3A, including Pi, LCD and margin; 0.8mm above ~0.78mm 2oz/10C estimate. Confirm regulator and load-switch thermal loss.
Switched 5.1V trunk carries 3.3A target before Pi/LCD branches; verify voltage drop and transients.

LCD_ILM.rationale: TPS259470 RPW adjacent land edges are only 0.200mm apart; 0.15mm is the declared fabrication clearance floor and permits the local escape. Trace-width and current limits are unchanged.

currentCapacity.rationale: I=0.048*(10C)^0.44*A^0.725 gives about 81 mil^2; at nominal 2oz (2.756 mil) this is 0.747mm. Use 1.2mm nominal and validate actual copper, vias, losses and temperature.

V5_LCD.rationale: TPS259470 RPW adjacent land edges are only 0.200mm apart; 0.15mm is the declared fabrication clearance floor and permits the local escape. Trace-width and current limits are unchanged.

footprintExceptions.rationale: Supplier land has a pad10 rectangle and overlapping pad10/VOUT3 polygon. Both are one physical VOUT terminal, joined also to VOUT pins8/9 per TI DML pin map. Preserve same logical port/net; do not treat polygon as an unconnected second net.

stitchingVias.name: ST_GND_FCu_1
stitchingVias.rationale: Run d93429fd: disconnected F.Cu filled region 1, area 14.0810 mm2. Point intersects this lobe and a >1000 mm2 filled GND region on another layer; checked all-layer tracks, vias and physical pads. Through via 0.6/0.3; no via-in-pad. Geometry evidence: routed-copper-dump; final KiCad DRC remains authoritative.
